title: Quick Roasted Ukrainian Bean Sprouts Roast
description: A festive Ukrainian dish featuring bean sprouts and roast, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It has a yeasty and aerated texture from the addition of baking powder.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the bean sprouts, onion, carrot, and potato with the olive oil, salt, black pepper, and baking powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the mixture out in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After 20 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the roasted bean sprouts and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
